title: Case 009: Front garden maintenance follow-up
initial_request: FRONT GARDEN - PICKED UP AT INSPECTION
overview: Northbridge Lettings followed up with the tenant about front garden maintenance noted at an inspection, requesting photographs to confirm completion. The tenant initially said the work was delayed because of a family medical situation, then said it would be completed and photos sent. After further follow-ups and a discussion about emails not coming through, the agency confirmed the tenant's email had arrived. No attachments are available in the record.
outcome: After receiving the photograph of the completed garden work, the task was closed.
